notes: Fiction removed: Indiana Jones and Lara Croft from archaeology (flag updated to archaeologists only), 'ent' (Tolkien) from mythical creatures. Kept 'tomb raider' (generic lowercase term) and 'Kratos' (Greek god of strength). Accents follow English Wikipedia forms (Göbekli Tepe, Çatalhöyük, Yazılıkaya, Ħaġar Qim, Copán, Kuélap, Māori macrons). Norse god names kept in the usual anglicised forms (Njord, Idun, Hodr) rather than Old Norse letters; only Ragnarök, Mjölnir, Jörmungandr, Jötunheim, Fáfnir, Fólkvangr, Sjöfn take marks. Separate: us presidents and inventors are bare surnames (Tyler, Pierce, Bell, Swan, Singer) that do not read as famous people; dig site is mostly everyday tools; fossils are palaeontology; greek monsters, trojan war heroes and norse mythology places are not gods.
